_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by <name>-<rust host triple>. This is the SECOND pin layer: the script already hard-pins the SHA-256 of every downloaded ARCHIVE, so these cover the exact unpacked bytes that get bundled and shipped. A mismatch hard-fails the fetch; a missing key logs the computed hash with pin instructions. Reset for ffmpeg 8.1.2 (2026-08-06, was 6.0 from the frozen ffmpeg-static npm package). mac arm64 pins computed on the owner's machine; windows + linux keys are intentionally absent until the first CI/release run prints them — copy them from that run's log, exactly as the 6.0-era Windows pins were captured. Linux never ships (CI-only sidecar), so pinning it is optional.
